title: Countable Mittag-Leffler towers are acyclic for inverse limit
statement: Let $(B_n,g_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse system of abelian groups [def-weil-inverse-system]. Suppose it is Mittag-Leffler [def-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler-system]: for every $n$ the images of $B_m\to B_n$ are constant for all sufficiently large $m$. Then $R^q\varprojlim_n B_n=0$ for every $q\geq1$, where the right derived functors of inverse limit on the abelian category of towers are those of [lem-pc-derived-limit-roos-abelian-groups].
